event_summary: A black kettlebell descends from above and comes to rest on top of a yellow mug on a wooden tabletop.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with a yellow mug standing upright on a wooden tabletop against a plain wall. A black kettlebell enters from the top of the frame, moves downward toward the mug, and its lower rounded body contacts the mug opening area. The kettlebell then remains positioned on top of the mug while the mug stays upright and visible beneath it.

reasons: The yellow mug and tabletop are visible at the start.
The kettlebell is not yet visible in the first frame.
